encephalopathy_grade.version: NCCP neurological action table; grading edition not specified

prior_ifos_neuro_grade.term: Prior worst ifosfamide-associated neurological event — named-event grade (central or peripheral)
prior_ifos_neuro_grade.guidance: Historical assessment: retain the worst prior event and its recovery separately from the current assessment. Distinguish altered alertness, confusion, hallucinations or seizures from peripheral sensory, motor or autonomic neuropathy. Record the exact event, objective findings, functional effects and interventions using the named-event criteria. Current CNS toxicity has its own separate Yes/No assessment.
